prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 flat-lay outfit card for a Telegram channel, e-commerce catalog style. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper area.

Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#obraz", and next to it a bold near-black headline: "Kuzgi ofis uslubi".

Arrange five clothing items neatly with generous spacing, each cleanly cut out with a soft realistic shadow:
1) a camel-beige single-breasted car coat, laid flat
2) a cream ribbed turtleneck sweater, neatly folded
3) black wide-leg dress trousers, folded
4) a pair of black heeled ankle boots, three-quarter angle
5) a small black rectangular shoulder bag

Next to each item place a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) circle with a white number — 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — matching the list order.

Bottom strip, above a thin divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo", right grey "5 element · 1 do'kon · $173.95".

Clean studio product photography, soft even lighting, muted palette (camel, cream, black). No people, no mannequins, no price tags.
One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Og'irliklar taxminiy (jami ≈3,6 kg), yetkazish 9,50 $/kg. Narx rang va o'lchamga qarab o'zgarishi mumkin. Bojxona qiymati = tovar + yetkazish = 208.15 $ (muallif qoidasi, 05.10.2026). Boj: (208.15 − 200) × 30 % = 2.45 $ (obrazda 3 $/kg minimal hisoblanmaydi — muallif). BKO yig'imi 110 000 so'm. Sumkasiz: 148.96 $ + ~3,2 kg × 9,50 = 30.40 $ → 179.36 $ (norma ichida).
